newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU mergers and takeovers - (UPDATED JULY 29).
newsitem.headline: EU mergers and takeovers - (UPDATED JULY 29).

text.p: The following are additions and deletions to the list of takeovers, mergers and joint ventures being reviewed by the European Commission under the European Union's merger regulation (*). The Commission has a month to clear or start a detailed, four-month probe after a deal has been filed.
**ADDITIONS
-- Plans by Klockner Stahl und Metallhandel GmbH, controlled by the VIAG group, to acquire control of Comercial de Laminados S.A. (Notified on July 22)
**DELETIONS

-- Proposal by Thyssen Stahl AG and Krupp Hoesch Stahl to pool their production and sale of flat steel products in a new joint venture called Thyssen Krupp Stahl. (Cleared on July 29 under the European Coal and Steel Community treaty. Other aspects of the deal are still being investigated under the EU's merger regulation)

-- Proposal by Compagnie Generale d'Entreprises Automobiles and Energie-Versorgung Schwaben AG to acquire joint control of German transport firm DEG-Verkehrs GmbH (Notified June 2 and cleared earlier this month. No press statement was issued).

-- Purchase by Germany's Lear Corporation GmbH, offshoot of the U.S. firm of the same name and producer of car seats and interior components, of Keiper Car Seating GmbH, a producer of complete seat systems in just-in-time sequence (Cleared on July 28)
-- Siemens and Thomson-CSF proposal to put their air traffic management activities into a joint venture called Airsys ATM SAS (Cleared on July 28)
** ON-GOING ONE-MONTH REVIEWS

-- Proposal by STET's Stet International Netherlands, Spain's Union Fenosa Inversiones and Grupo Electrico de Telecommunicaciones, which belongs the the Endesa group, to acquire joint control of Retevision (Notified July 15)
-- Proposed joint venture between Philips Electronics NV and Lucent Technologies Inc of the United States in the consumer telephones market (Notified July 14)
-- Plans by computer companies Compaq and Tandem to merge (Notified on July 10)
-- Proposal by RS Partnership AG, which belongs to Stinnes AG, and Haniel Reederei Holding GmbH to share control of Belgian shipping company De Grave NV (Notified July 9)

-- Plans by the German unit of ADM International Ltd, subsidiary of U.S. Archer Daniels Midland, and British Acatos & Hutcheson plc to acquire joint control of Soya Mainz GmbH & Co (Notified on July 8)
-- Certain aspects of the proposed joint venture between Thyssen Stahl AG and Krupp Hoesch Stahl, including production of steel tubes. (Notified July 7)
-- Proposal by Norsk Alcoa A/S, controlled by Aluminium Company of America, and Elkem ASA to acquire joint control of Elkem Aluminium ANS (Notified July 4)
-- Proposal by Kloeckner Stahl und Metallhandel GmbH, a unit of VIAG, to acquire control of steel distributor ODS Hoogovens Handel BV (Notified July 2)
-- VEBA AG's proposed takeover of Degussa AG (Notified July 2)

-- Proposal by Germany's Daimler Benz AG and Deutsche Telekom AG to create and take joint control of a new company, Telematik GmbH, specialising in traffic control systems for cars (Notified June 27) ** DETAILED REVIEWS
-- Siemens AG's proposed takeover of Swiss company Elektrowatt AG (Full probe opened on July 29)
-- Proposed merger between Guinness Plc and Grand Metropolitan Plc (Full probe opened June 20)
-- Proposed Nordic soft drinks joint venture of Coca-Cola and Carlsberg A/S of Denmark. (Full probe opened May 2)
-- Boeing Co proposed acquisition of McDonnell Douglas. (Full probe opened March 19, Commission took "positive stance" on July 23. Final decision on July 30)

(*) Commission has exclusive EU competence in corporate concentrations involving firms with a combined global turnover of 5.0 billion ecus and EU turnover of 250 million ecus each. It has the power to block, or force changes to, deals which create or strengthen dominant positions in the EU whether or not the companies involved are European.
